description: Read a run's status, steps, results and time left. A control token also sees the form_url and wake_url of a step waiting for an answer, each a link to hand to whoever should answer. wait_seconds, up to 25, waits for a change or the end before answering. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

run_id.description: The run_id returned at creation; not a credential.

token.description: The read_token or the control_token returned once at creation.

name: read_agent_run
title: Read an agent run
